title: National Consumer Helpline: grievance redressal
authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
scope: Consumer grievance routing only; no remedy entitlement.
summary: Consumers can register grievances through NCH channels. NCH forwards grievances to the concerned entity; consumers can track responses.
verification_note: Opened the official HTML page and read the grievance journey on 2026-11-09.
limitations: NCH routing does not guarantee a refund or replace legal proceedings.

claims.en: You can raise a consumer grievance through the National Consumer Helpline and track the response. This does not guarantee a refund.
claims.hi: आप राष्ट्रीय उपभोक्ता हेल्पलाइन पर शिकायत दर्ज करके जवाब देख सकते हैं। इससे रिफंड की गारंटी नहीं मिलती।

title: NCH knowledge base: Consumer Protection Act 2019
authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
scope: General online-purchase coverage only; not an individual eligibility determination.
summary: The guidance includes online transactions in consumer purchases. Resale/commercial-purpose exclusions and the self-employment livelihood qualification require care.
verification_note: Opened and read questions 3–4. Other FAQ sections were not approved for use.
limitations: Official guidance is not a consolidated statute. Commission thresholds, filing portals, deadlines, and business-purchase eligibility are excluded from this record.

claims.en: NCH guidance includes online purchases within consumer transactions. Whether a particular purchase qualifies needs attention to exclusions, including commercial purpose.
claims.hi: NCH की जानकारी में ऑनलाइन खरीद भी उपभोक्ता लेनदेन में शामिल है। किसी खरीद पर नियम लागू होने के लिए व्यावसायिक उद्देश्य जैसी सीमाएँ देखनी होंगी।

title: NALSA: Legal Aid
scope: Qualified legal-help routing; eligibility is not assessed by this application.
locator: Claiming Free Legal Aid / Application Procedure, question 1; eligibility FAQs
summary: Depending on jurisdiction, applicants may approach the appropriate Taluk, District or State legal services institution. Legal-aid eligibility must be checked.
verification_note: Followed the Legal Aid link from the official homepage and read application-routing and eligibility sections.
limitations: No promise of free representation, acceptance, response time, or case outcome.

claims.en: Ask the appropriate District or State Legal Services Authority about legal help and eligibility, or consult a qualified lawyer. Free legal aid is not guaranteed for every applicant.
claims.hi: उचित जिला या राज्य विधिक सेवा प्राधिकरण से कानूनी मदद और पात्रता पूछें, या योग्य वकील से सलाह लें। हर आवेदक को मुफ्त सहायता की गारंटी नहीं है।

title: PIB: Model Tenancy Act circulated for state/UT adoption
authority: Press Information Bureau, Government of India
scope: Historical policy context only, not an enacted nationwide deposit rule.
summary: The Cabinet approved circulation of the Model Tenancy Act to states and union territories for adaptation through new legislation or amendments.
verification_note: Read the release body at the final redirected URL. No state adoption or present statutory entitlement was verified.
limitations: State enactment, applicability, deposit caps, refund periods, and lawful deductions require separate verification.

claims.en: The Model Tenancy Act was circulated for state/UT adaptation. It is not evidence that one deposit rule applies everywhere; the applicable state law must be checked.
claims.hi: मॉडल किरायेदारी अधिनियम राज्यों और केंद्रशासित प्रदेशों में अपनाने के लिए भेजा गया था। इससे पूरे भारत में एक ही जमा-राशि नियम लागू होना सिद्ध नहीं होता; राज्य का कानून जाँचना होगा।
